source: docs/north-east-d1/published-network.json (Nico oracle-clash-report, 31 Aug 2026) + Jim's D2 GTFS pull
notes: National Rail (Darwin/OpenLDBWS) is structurally catalogued here but blocked at the account level - DARWIN_LDB_TOKEN not set. Same blocker as uk-west-midlands / uk-ellesmere-port / east-midlands / south-yorkshire.

Tyne and Wear Metro: D1 pack named DFT Bus Open Data Service (f-bus~dft~gov~uk, no key) as the static GTFS source. Jim pulled the confirmed no-key bulk archive (https://data.bus-data.dft.gov.uk/timetable/download/gtfs-file/all/, itm_all_gtfs.zip, ~1.46GB) fresh on 31 Aug 2026 to close the D1 pack's intermediate-stop-order gap. UNLIKE East Midlands' NET, Tyne and Wear Metro (agency_id OP241, 'Tyne and Wear Metro') IS present in the archive with real route/trip/stop_times data for both lines. Green Line: 31 confirmed stations (South Hylton to Newcastle Airport, matches the oracle report's stated count exactly). Yellow Line: 41 confirmed unique stations (St James to South Shields via the coastal loop and Gateshead, matches the oracle report's stated count exactly; Monument served twice per single physical trip due to the loop shape, deduped to one catalog entry here). This also RESOLVES the D1 pack's open question 'does Yellow call Pelaw?' - CONFIRMED YES by GTFS stop_times (Yellow line calls Pelaw between Heworth and Hebburn).

Full ordered per-line station lists (used for the line+terminus direction model, not stored again here) live in lib/cities/north-east/marketing-directions.js. Each metro stop below carries a representative single platform stopId for uk/catalog.js dispatch only - the full multi-platform stopId set (lib/cities/north-east/metro-stops.json) is kept on disk for a future feed but is no longer loaded by lib/providers/north-east.js, which does not build a Metro board.

METRO IS OUT-PRODUCT (Tim, 5 Sep 2026, walk-up-rule precedent from East Midlands' NET): no confirmed public real-time feed exists (the only candidate, metro-rti.nexus.org.uk, is undocumented and app-only) and the app does not offer a static-timetable board dressed up as live. The 60 Metro catalog entries below are kept, not deleted, so Newcastle Central's doNotGroup and Sunderland's shared-platform note still resolve, and so a future confirmed Nexus feed slots in without a catalog rebuild. fetchMetroStopBoard() in lib/providers/north-east.js throws MetroFeedUnconfirmedError before any network call. The 5.4GB/1.46GB DFT archive is never fetched by the app at request time or in any job - see docs/jim-brief-north-east-metro-out-product.md and docs/united-kingdom-ledger.md §3/§4. Outreach draft: docs/outreach-drafts/north-east-nexus.md, pending a Nexus reply.

Newcastle Central hub: National Rail platforms use CRS NCL and the printed name 'Newcastle Central'. Metro's own GTFS stop_name for the same hub is 'Central Station' (Tyne and Wear Metro Station) - different printed names, consistent with doNotGroup (no name-collapse risk since the strings differ).

Sunderland: genuine shared-platform case, NOT doNotGroup - see the 'class' field on both the train and metro Sunderland entries below and docs/north-east-d1/direction-model-memo.md. CRS SUN live-verified 5 Sep 2026 for the National Rail side (the oracle report gave no code).

Pelaw: Metro-only junction/station (both Green and Yellow call it, confirmed by GTFS - see above). No separate National Rail station exists at Pelaw per the oracle report - not catalogued under mode train.
Berwick-upon-Tweed (BWK) included as National Rail-only per the oracle report's station table. Northern boundary against a future Rest-of-Scotland pack is open/unresolved - not closed here.

Darlington (DAR) was EXCLUDED (unclaimed by both North East's own report and East Midlands' already-merged pack) until docs/united-kingdom-ledger.md section 2 decided its home region as North East (Tim, 5 Sep 2026, County Durham/ECML, no real second claimant). Added in UK station fill phase 2a (14 Sep 2026) per that ruling — see docs/uk-station-fill/assignment.md.

Newcastle Central and Berwick-upon-Tweed lat/lng superseded 7 Sep 2026 (uk-catalog-geocode) — NaPTAN RailReferences now supplies confirmed CRS-keyed coordinates for both, independent of the coordinate source gap that previously applied. Sunderland's train entry reuses its Metro/GTFS coordinate since it is the same physical platform (unchanged).
Coordinates: NaPTAN RailReferences (CRS->coords) pulled 2026-09-07; 3/3 rail stations geocoded | no confirmed source pulled 2026-09-07; 60/60 tram/metro stops geocoded; no exceptions

7 Sep 2026 (docs/jim-brief-no-live-feed-stops-out-of-picker.md): all 60 Tyne and Wear Metro (mode metro) stops flagged liveFeed: false — MetroFeedUnconfirmedError means no board can ever be produced, so these stops stay in the catalog (coordinates kept for coverage notes and a future re-enable) but are no longer offered in the station picker or Near me. National Rail (mode train) stops are unaffected.

stops.name: Sunderland
stops.class: genuine shared-platform through-running station - NOT doNotGroup. Board must mix both services once National Rail is unblocked, tagged by mode/operator, not split into separate tabs. CRS SUN live-verified 5 Sep 2026. See docs/north-east-d1/direction-model-memo.md and hazard-pack.md H1.
